messages:
sara_support: Customer opened a ticket — embeddings usage chart in Console is showing units labeled as `tokens` but numbers look like vector counts and totals are ~3x billing. Screenshot attached. They say it started after last week's dashboard deploy.
olivia_analytics: Can you paste the org id + exact repro steps and screenshot link?
sara_support: Org: acme-data (org_987). Repro steps: 1) Console > Analytics > Embeddings usage 2) date 2024-10-01..2024-10-07 3) group by route. Chart legend shows 'tokens' but hover tooltip reports 'vectors' and raw numbers match vector counts. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/shot123
kevin_prod: I flagged a frontend change last week: deploy/2024-10-08-embeds-legend. @deploy-bot did that go out?
deploy-bot: deploy/2024-10-08-embeds-legend succeeded in prod at 2024-10-08T03:12Z
jun_eng: I can dig in. Need a sample metric event and a time window to trace through the ingestion pipeline.
sara_support: Customer provided a sample event: event_id=evt_abc123 payload: `\{"type\":\"embedding_submission\",\"units\":400000,\"unit_type\":\"vectors\",\"route\":\"/embed\"\}`. They also have two API keys and multiple routes.
olivia_analytics: Looking at ingestion traces for org_987 around 2024-10-03, I see the event goes through `unit_normalize` then through `legacy_compat_unit_map`. It appears both transformers ran because the route matched two different regex rules (`/embed` and `/embed.*`). That caused the unit mapping to be applied twice and the aggregator to count the event more than once.
jun_eng: Sounds like the pipeline isn't idempotent — legacy map shouldn't run if unit_normalize already set a flag. I'll open a hotfix PR to gate legacy_compat_unit_map on a `unit_normalized` flag or make it no-op if units present.
rachael_billing: Heads up — billing ran last night. If counts were duplicated we'll bill customers incorrectly. We need to identify impacted orgs and pause invoice generation for them until we reconcile.
jun_eng: I ran a quick check: the duplication multiplier varies (2x or 3x) depending on overlapping regex matches. I'll run a precise SQL to get affected orgs and exact multipliers. ETA for patch + deploy ~90 minutes. Short-term mitigation: add a dashboard banner "usage under investigation" for flagged orgs and suspend auto-billing for those orgs.
kevin_prod: Good plan. @olivia_analytics can you produce a list of orgs where reported token units > billing_expected*1.5 in the last 7 days? Rachael, we'll hold invoices for those orgs.
olivia_analytics: Running now. Top results: org_987, org_112, org_204. Creating an internal alert and adding a temporary dashboard note flag for these orgs.
deploy-bot: Start deploy: hotfix/metrics-dedupe to prod at 2024-10-09T05:20Z
jun_eng: Patch merged and deployed. Hotfix ensures the legacy compatibility mapping is skipped if `unit_normalized=true` and fixes overlapping regex rules. I also queued a backfill job to dedupe aggregated counts in the affected windows. Backfill job id will follow.
alertbot: Backfill job job_556 queued; estimated completion 45m.
rachael_billing: I've credited org_987 for the inflated day and notified support. Will withhold final invoice adjustments until backfill completes and we confirm totals.
sara_support: Notified customer with interim note and ETA. They asked for a dashboard annotation so end-users see "units may be under investigation" — I added a temporary banner.
jun_eng: Post-mortem notes: root cause was transformer regex overlap + non-idempotent unit mapping. Action items: add unit-mapping regression tests, ensure unit_normalized flag is canonical, add pipeline integration tests, and update frontend to always read canonical `unit_type` from the event instead of rendering best-effort legend. I'll draft the post-mortem.
sara_support: :thumbsup: Will close this thread after backfill completes and invoices are reconciled.
